name: Hindu Kush
summary: Hindu Kush is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] named for the mountain range along the border of [[country:AF|Afghanistan]] and [[country:PK|Pakistan]], where its resin was long gathered for hashish. It is the root of the Kush line, a parent of [[skunk-kush|Skunk Kush]] and Master Kush, and Leafly lists it in the ancestry of OG Kush.

origin.place: Hindu Kush range, Afghanistan and Pakistan

sources.title: Hindu Kush
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the name from the range between Pakistan and Afghanistan, the pure-indica landrace description, resin prized by hash makers, and a 7–9 week flowering time.
